newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni to launch 6 bln 5-yr private bonds.
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni to launch 6 bln 5-yr private bonds.

text.p: The largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s., will place six billion crowns in 5-year bonds with selected investors in February, the bank said on Thursday.
In a statement published in the Czech official business gazette, the bank said the bonds will be priced at par with yield at 0.15 percent above the six month Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR).
The bonds, once issued, can be publicly traded according to Czech law, it said.
The group selected for the placement was not disclosed.
Issue date has been set for February 10, and interest will be payable twice-yearly.
Each bond will carry a nominal value of 10,000 crowns, Komercni said.
